parameters.text:
Read this bill/invoice and extract the details in clean JSON.

Return only valid JSON with this structure:
{
  "supplier_name": "",
  "invoice_number": "",
  "date": "",
  "gstin": "",
  "payment_mode": "",
  "subtotal": "",
  "gst_total": "",
  "round_off": "",
  "grand_total": "",
  "items": [
    {
      "description": "",
      "qty": "",
      "rate": "",
      "amount": "",
      "gst_percent": ""
    }
  ]
}

Rules:
- Extract all visible line items.
- Keep numbers exactly as written.
- If a field is missing, return an empty string.
- Return JSON only, no explanation.

parameters.formDescription: Upload your bill or invoice to extract details automatically.
